STEP 1 - Scene: A light lunch or side salad plate: mixed leafy greens, cantaloupe cubes, strawberries and blueberries, plus roasted potato pieces.

STEP 2 - Vessel: White square plate, roughly 26 cm across (dinner plate). Area = 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Mixed leafy greens (spinach/leaf mix)
- Cantaloupe (melon) cubes
- Strawberries (two halves/pieces)
- Blueberries (about 8-10)
- Roasted/baked potato pieces (4 pieces)

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate, sums to about 60% covered):
- Leafy greens: ~22% (about 115 cm^2), height ~3 cm
- Cantaloupe: ~10% (about 53 cm^2), height ~1.5 cm
- Strawberries: ~4% (about 21 cm^2), height ~1.5 cm
- Blueberries: ~2% (about 11 cm^2), height ~1 cm
- Roasted potatoes: ~8% (about 42 cm^2), height ~2 cm

STEP 5 - Volume (area x height):
- Greens: 115 x 3 = 345 ml
- Cantaloupe: 53 x 1.5 = 80 ml
- Strawberries: 21 x 1.5 = 32 ml
- Blueberries: 11 x 1 = 11 ml
- Potatoes: 42 x 2 = 84 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Greens: 345 x 0.15 = 52 g
- Cantaloupe: 80 x 0.6 = 48 g
- Strawberries: 32 x 0.6 = 19 g
- Blueberries: 11 x 0.6 = 7 g
- Potatoes: 84 x 0.9 = 76 g (dense, roasted)

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Greens: 52 g x 23 kcal/100g ≈ 12 kcal
- Cantaloupe: 48 g x 34 kcal/100g ≈ 16 kcal
- Strawberries: 19 g x 32 kcal/100g ≈ 6 kcal
- Blueberries: 7 g x 57 kcal/100g ≈ 4 kcal
- Potatoes: 76 g x 150 kcal/100g (roasted, cooked) ≈ 114 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 202 g and ≈ 152 kcal. This fits a side-salad-sized portion covering about 60% of a dinner plate. Oil or dressing is not clearly visible, so none is added.
